subject: Glucostat tablets wrong colour - photo attached
body_text:
Hello,

I opened a new box of Glucostat this morning, lot GS-9931-C, and the tablets are pale yellow. My previous boxes were always white. Some of them also look chipped.

I have not taken any of them. I have attached a photograph so you can see the difference.

Ana Beltran, Valencia, Spain
